format: Each canonical scalar is UTF-8 string or null; money/identifiers/tags use JSON-encoded strings in Parquet/JSONL for uniform Arrow schema. Source tables preserve richer original schemas.

fields.document_id: Source + stable identity/content hash; exact source duplicates may repeat; no row-number-only identity. PDF uses snapshot SHA256 + page.
fields.source_record_id: Source-provided key or documented composite; may collide across revisions
fields.award_key: Source-native composite award key; for SBIR contract alone is not globally sufficient
fields.transaction_key: USAspending transaction unique key; not a prime/subaward key
fields.entity_key: UEI preferred; legacy DUNS fallback; do not assume identifier equivalence
fields.source_url: Record link when available; otherwise source portal plus raw locator
fields.raw_locator: Filename + CSV data row, source key, XML opportunity ID or PDF physical page
fields.money_json: Source field names and string decimal values; dictionary determines grain and unit
fields.eligibility: Candidate/intent/context flags, not editorial inclusion decision
fields.capability_tags: Transparent regex features, not novelty or quality scoring
fields.identifiers_json: Original keys, agency/branch, solicitation and topic references where available
fields.record_sha256: Hash of canonicalized raw CSV row
fields.source_snapshot_sha256: Raw file hash; source snapshot/vintage boundary
fields.action_date: Source action date, opportunity posting date or SBIR performance-start date; semantics vary by source
fields.retrieved_at: UTC retrieval timestamp, not effective/award/publication date
